title: Comptroller and Auditor General
quote: Ambedkar: the CAG is the most important officer under the Constitution

boxes.title: Articles 148-151
head: Art.
Content
rows: **Form of accounts**: President on CAG's advice

boxes.title: Tenure & independence
items: Removed **like an SC judge**: address by both Houses, special majority
Not at President's pleasure; resigns to **President**
**1971 Act**; accounts separated from audit **1 March 1976**

boxes.title: Audits & limits
items: Consolidated, **Contingency** & **Public Accounts** of Union, States, UTs with legislature
PSUs: **DVC, ONGC** direct; **LIC, RBI** wholly private
==**Auditor General, not Comptroller**==: no control over issue of money (unlike **British** CAG)
Cannot disallow spending; **secret service** expenditure excluded

boxes.title: PAC & landmark reports
head: Item
Fact
rows: Set up **1921**; **22** members (15 LS + 7 RS); chair from Opposition since **1967**

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Longest term vs President, VP, MP: **CAG** (APPSC-G2 2017)
Reports go to **President/Governor**, not directly to PAC
